# Vertex AI Release Notes Summary — captured 2026-05-27

## Latest Updates (May 2026)

**May 26, 2026** - Colab Enterprise: Data Science Agent now generally available. Automates exploratory data analysis, performs machine learning tasks, and delivers insights directly within Colab Enterprise notebooks.

**May 26, 2026** - Vertex AI Extensions marked for deprecation (effective November 26, 2026); migrate to Agent Platform. [DEPRECATION — not coverage-relevant]

## April 2026

**April 17, 2026** - RAG Cross Corpus Retrieval now in public preview, enabling retrieval from multiple corpora simultaneously

**April 14, 2026** - Claude Opus 4.7 available in Model Garden

**April 13, 2026** - Visualization cells for Colab Enterprise generally available

**April 10, 2026** - SQL cells for Colab Enterprise generally available

**April 6, 2026** - Metadata search for RAG Engine using schema-based filtering

**April 3, 2026** - Gemma 4 26B A4B IT experimental launch; RAG Engine Serverless mode in public preview

**April 2, 2026** - Veo 3.1 Lite released (cost-efficient option); Gemini 2.5 model retirement dates updated to October 16, 2026

## Key Announcements

- **Vector Search 2.0** (March 5, 2026) - Now generally available with collections, auto-embeddings, and hybrid search
- **Vertex AI Agent Engine** (March 4, 2025) - Generally available with billing starting that date
- **Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro** (June 17, 2025) - Now generally available with updated pricing

## Major Feature Releases

- Live API for Gemini (private GA, June 2025)
- Veo 3 and 3.1 video generation (generally available, July 2025)
- Agent Development Kit in preview (April 2025)
- Agent Garden in preview (April 2025)

## Last Fetched
2026-05-27 — NEW: Colab Enterprise Data Science Agent GA (May 26, 2026). Vertex AI Extensions deprecation announced (May 26, 2026; not reportable). URL redirects to docs.cloud.google.com.
